subject: Authorization request: EU/APAC failover simulation + residency constraints
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: ops+pbank@pioneerbank.com, alicia.murthy@pioneerbank.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Authorization request: EU/APAC failover simulation + residency constraints

Hi Alicia / Pioneer SREs,

Per our rollout calendar, we want to run a controlled failover simulation on Thursday (2027-07-01) to validate the EU -> APAC warm-standby path for your private VPC deployment. This test will exercise:

- Control-plane handoff (verification tokens only)
- KV/prefix cache rehydration from EU to APAC standby nodes
- Egress gating confirmation (no data crosses non-approved jurisdictions)

Before we run the sim we need:
1) Your written authorization to perform the scheduled simulation and temporary routing changes (DocuSign or reply OK is fine).
2) Confirmation that Pioneer’s KMS key alias (projects/pioneer/keys/rdw-kms-prod) can be accessed by the APAC standby during the test window under the existing IAM trust.
3) Any legal/contractual constraints we should observe (data residency clauses, allowed transient copies, retention limits).

Attached: Pioneer MAF (redacted) and our simulation plan for reference.

Proposed window: Thu 2027-07-01 02:00–03:00 UTC (low traffic). We will limit production impact, run read-only verification steps first, and abort on any policy mismatch.

Please confirm by EOD today so we can lock the change window and inform on-call.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: pioneerbank-maf-2027.pdf (pdf), eu-apac-failover-sim-plan-20270628.pdf (pdf)

From: ops+pbank@pioneerbank.com <ops+pbank@pioneerbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: alicia.murthy@pioneerbank.com, legal@pioneerbank.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Authorization request: EU/APAC failover simulation + residency constraints

Neha —

Thanks for the heads up. Pioneer SRE team is OK to proceed with the planned simulation subject to the following:

- We need confirmation that the APAC standby will not persist any customer PII outside of the approved EU/UK/AU pools. Transient KV caching for session tokens is OK if it is zero-copy or TTL < 5 minutes.
- KMS access: our security team requires a scoped, time-limited IAM role for the simulation (we can issue a short-lived delegate role). We do NOT want blanket cross-region KMS access.
- Legal has requested a short notice to review the simulation report before any follow-up production changes. Please include the sim report and the list of S3 keys accessed.

We will sign the authorization doc (DocuSign) once the IAM scoping is in place.

— Pioneer SRE (ops+pbank)

Attachment: pioneer-acceptance-checklist-20270628.xlsx (referenced)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: ops+pbank@pioneerbank.com, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorization request: EU/APAC failover simulation + residency constraints

Thanks — copying the infra runbook owners. Quick notes from infra:

- We will implement a time-limited KMS delegate role (STS assume-role with external ID) for the APAC standby; role lifetime = 30 minutes. That satisfies the scoped access ask.
- We will enforce TTL=120s for any ephemeral session tokens stored in KV cache during the sim; persistent objects will not be written.
- During the window we will capture a minimized artifact set: KV cache summary, control-plane handoff trace, and S3 object list (no payloads).

Jonas / Mina — can you prepare the sim orchestration and the artifacts export? I will prepare the IAM doc for Pioneer to sign.

— Karthik

Cc: ops+pbank@pioneerbank.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 12:44:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Authorization request: EU/APAC failover simulation + residency constraints

All —

Orchestration plan (summary):
1) Dry-run (no KMS calls, control-plane only) 02:00–02:05 UTC — smoke validation.
2) Scoped KMS test (delegate role) 02:05–02:20 UTC — read-only decrypt checks against token keys.
3) KV cache rehydration test (read-only objects, TTL enforced 120s) 02:20–02:35 UTC.
4) Audit capture and rollback confirmation 02:35–02:40 UTC.

We will log the sequence and emit an artifact bundle to the shared Drive folder (link below). If any step fails a hard abort with automatic route rollback will be executed.

Drive folder (write-only for Pioneer): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1Xy_dummy_drive_link_failover_plan

Mina — please ensure the sim report template includes: list of S3 object keys accessed (no contents), KMS role ARNs assumed, audit trace head IDs, and a short privacy impact statement.

— Jonas

From: Alicia Murthy <alicia.murthy@pioneerbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@pioneerbank.com, ops+pbank@pioneerbank.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 14:47:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Authorization request: EU/APAC failover simulation + residency constraints

Neha / team —

Thanks, this looks good. Legal reviewed the attached MAF and is comfortable with the limited sim provided:

- Pioneer signs the DocuSign authorization once the IAM delegate role and short-lived credentials are in place.
- We need a one-hour window after the sim to review the report (legal hold-back). Please mark the artifacts as "Pioneer-review-only" until we confirm.

Please proceed with the IAM doc and send DocuSign link. We will return signed authorization by 2027-06-29 18:00 UTC.

Best,
Alicia Murthy
Product Ops | Pioneer Bank
Alicia.Murthy@pioneerbank.com
